patterns.note: The site features a multi-stage interactive introduction, starting with a full-screen circuit-board aesthetic, transitioning to a dynamic HUD interface, before finally revealing the main content page on scroll.

A high-contrast dark mode is consistently used, featuring black backgrounds, white text, and distinct neon accent palettes that shift across different interactive stages (green/purple for initial load, red/white for HUD, then subtle red/orange gradients for content graphics).

Display typography is characterized by extremely large, bold sans-serif headings that command attention, contrasted with smaller, often monospaced or technical-looking text for UI elements and detailed descriptions.

The entire page experience is driven by a sequential reveal: an initial full-screen graphic transitions to an interactive HUD with a central warp animation, which then completely disappears on scroll to reveal the main content, with elements fading and sliding into view.

Content sections on the main page are visually separated by generous vertical spacing and often feature large, singular graphical elements or animated illustrations that relate to the surrounding text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated, multi-stage interactive introduction using canvas and Lottie animations. This sequence starts with an initial full-screen graphic, transitions to a dynamic HUD with a central animation, and then fully unmounts or transitions out on scroll to reveal the main content. Subsequent content sections are revealed with scroll-triggered fade-in and subtle transform animations.
A strong grid system underpins the layout, providing precise alignment for both interactive UI elements and static content, often subtly reinforced by background grid lines or crosshair markers.

Typography is used as a primary visual element, with extremely large, bold sans-serif headings creating dramatic impact against a dark background, complemented by a secondary, more technical typeface for UI and body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold display headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual anchors, complemented by smaller, often monospaced, technical labels and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp — all elements feature crisp, angular corners, reinforcing a precise, technical aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy — generous negative space surrounds content blocks and large headings, creating a sense of precision and focus, especially in the main content sections.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its elaborate, multi-stage interactive introduction that completely transforms the user experience from an immersive, animated interface into a minimalist, typography-focused content page on scroll. This dramatic narrative progression and visual transformation create a highly memorable and engaging first impression.
